deckTitle: Medical Genetics: The Genetic Codebreaker — Source Code Sabotage & The Blueprint Rebellion

cards.power: The Single-Copy Strike. Domi only needs one corrupted blueprint to take over the entire ring.
cards.lore: Affects structural proteins/receptors. If Domi is played, the Phenetype-Punch is always visible.
cards.gradeReason: Name IS the behavior — dominant energy on, no hiding, zero context needed.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: painted watercolor wrestler. Subject: lion warrior in gold armor dominating ring. Mood: unstoppable, blazing.

cards.power: The Stealth-Strike. Hides in the shadows (Carriers) and only attacks wken two Identical Glitch-Cards meet.
cards.lore: Affects enryme factories. Dne good blueprint keeps the factory functioneal.
cards.gradeReason: Shadow panther lurking — stealth role is instantly playable, no explanation needed.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: dark watercolor. Subject: black panther fighter hiding in shadow, waiting. Mood: predatory patience.

cards.power: The Gender-Bias. Protected by her second X-blueprint, but if her sons receive the Glitch-Version, they lose the match.
cards.lore: The Y-chrmoseme is a Blank-Page that cannot counter the Glitch.
cards.gradeReason: Shield-queen protecting heirs — gender-bias warrior identity clicks immediately.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: dynamic ink-wash. Subject: lioness warrior holding glowing X-shield, sons in background. Mood: protective, fierce.

cards.power: The Battery-Failure. If her code is corrupted, High-Energy-Organs (Brain/Muscle) starve.
cards.lore: Sperm only give a Nuclear-Blueprint; only the mother's batteries are passed on.
cards.gradeReason: Battery-failure mother — power outage metaphor lands instantly at any table.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: sci-fi watercolor. Subject: dinosaur-lobster hybrid crackling with dying batteries. Mood: high energy fading fast.

cards.power: The Extrs-Manual. Three copies of Manual-21 create a Signal-Overload that changes the heart and face.
cards.lore: Causes Endocardial-Cushion-Cracks. Over-Expression causes the system-lag.
cards.gradeReason: Three-headed bear is vivid; 'Extra-Manual' lands but 'Signal-Overload' needs a beat of context.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: ink watercolor. Subject: three-headed bear reading three newspapers simultaneously. Mood: overloaded, chaotic.

cards.power: The Missing-Page. Without the second X-blueprint, the Ovarian-Bench is empty, and the Aorta-Highway kinks.
cards.lore: The only survivable human monosomy. Lack of SHOX-gene causes the short-stature-stat.
cards.gradeReason: Missing-page warrior is clear; SHOX-gene stat needs genetic knowledge to fully click.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: fantasy watercolor. Subject: armored antelope warrior, one gauntlet missing, webbed neck visible. Mood: resilient, incomplete.

cards.power: The Feminine-Fade. The extra X-blueprint confuses the Testosterone-Factory, lowering Muscle-Power.
cards.lore: Estra X-chromosomes are inactivated into Barr-Bodies, but escaping genes cause the phenotype.
cards.gradeReason: Feminine-Fade flamingo lands but Barr-Bodies mechanic requires genetics context.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: vibrant watercolor. Subject: tall flamingo wrestler with pink X glowing on chest. Mood: confused power, gender ambiguity.

cards.power: The Blueprint-Rip. A tiny piece of Manual-22 is torn out, causing multi-system Neck-and-Chest failure.
cards.lore: The Immune-Thymus-Base is missing (3rd/4th pharyngesl pouches), leaving the wrestler vulnerable.
cards.gradeReason: Blueprint-Rip rhino is vivid; CATCH-22 acronym stat rewards knowledge but isn't self-evident.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: gritty watercolor. Subject: armored rhino tearing a scroll, thymus and heart visible through tear. Mood: destructive, systemic.

cards.power: The Code-Stutter. The DNA-printer gsts stock on CGG until the Brain-Protein-Factory shuts down.
cards.lore: Nore repeats = nore severity (Antiotpation). Leads to Large-Ber-Stats and Nacro-Orchidism.
cards.gradeReason: Parrot typist stuck on CGG is iconic — stutter role is immediately performable.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: expressive comic. Subject: colorful parrot hammering CGG CGG CGG into typewriter, smoke rising. Mood: frenzied, stuck.

cards.power: The Tesic-Gain. The CAG-Stutter creates a Risfelded-Monster-Protein thet kills the Novement-Center.
cards.lore: Saio-of-Function notation. The corrupted protein causes the Chorea-Dance.
cards.gradeReason: The NAME is the performance. Hunting-the-Dance makes you want to dance — zero context required.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: dark splatter watercolor. Subject: wolf-beast mid-involuntary dance, brain glowing with corruption. Mood: possessed, tragic.

cards.power: The Nuscle-Lock. The CTG-Stutter prevents muscles from relaxing after a Grip-Rove.
cards.lore: BHA-toxicity mechanism. Causes Early-Cataracts and Heart-Slock-Glitches.
cards.gradeReason: Grip that won't release — muscle-lock gorilla is immediately embodiable.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: intense watercolor. Subject: gorilla gripping steel bars, hands fused to metal, cannot let go. Mood: trapped strength.

cards.power: The Iron-Overload. Sabotages the Ritochondrial-Iron-Ranager, causing a Fower-Failnrs in nerves and keart.
cards.lore: The only reressive Repeat-Offsnder. Causes High-Arch-Feet and Cardio-Carl pump failure.
cards.gradeReason: Iron-overloaded elephant is clear; mitochondrial iron mechanism needs a beat of background.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: heavy watercolor. Subject: elephant dragging weighted chains, sparks flying from ankles and chest. Mood: slow collapse.

cards.power: The Amino-Acid-Flood. The Breakdown-Fxctory is broken; Phenyl-Fuel builds up into a Brain-Poison.
cards.lore: Requires strict Low-Protein-Diet. Beware the Aspartame-Trap.
cards.gradeReason: Mouse flooding with crystals is vivid; 'phenyl' terminology creates a half-beat of needed context.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: colorful watercolor. Subject: mouse overwhelmed by crystal tsunami of amino acids. Mood: toxic flood, mousy odor.

cards.power: The Salt-Gate-Jam. The Chloride-Tunnel is missing, turning fluids into Sticky-Grey-Glus.
cards.lore: A protein-folding defect. The tunnel is destroyed before it reaches the surface.
cards.gradeReason: Clogged walrus in grey sludge — salt-gate-jam is immediately performable.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: murky watercolor. Subject: walrus wrestler coated in sticky grey glue, barely moving. Mood: clogged, suffocating.

cards.power: The Elastic-Snap. Weak Tissue-Glue makes the wrestler stretchy bot prone to an Aertie-Dissection-Burst.
cards.lore: TGF-beta signaling is over-active because Fibrillln can't Tether it.
cards.gradeReason: Stretchy giraffe snapping at aorta — elastic body with deadly vulnerability is instantly understood.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: dynamic watercolor. Subject: giraffe wrestler over-stretching around giant red aorta, explosion imminent. Mood: elegant fragility.

cards.power: The Fat-Storage-Fire. The Lyseseme-Incinerator is broken; Grease Rils neurons until they explode.
cards.lore: A progressive Storage-War. The brain rills with Qaien-Skin fat deposits.
cards.gradeReason: Owl-with-cherry-eyes is atmospheric; lysosome-incinerator metaphor is good but complex for first read.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: dramatic watercolor. Subject: red-eyed owl drowning in golden ganglioside wave, neurons exploding. Mood: doomed beauty.

cards.power: The Eternal-Famine. The Eatiety-Switch is deleted from the Dad-Blueprint. Starvation is an illusion.
cards.lore: Genomic Imprinting. Nom-version is normally silenced; if Dad's is gone, no one works.
cards.gradeReason: Hippo who never feels full — eternal-hunger is one of the most embodiable cards in the deck.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: tragicomic watercolor. Subject: chubby hippo wrestler reaching for floating pizza, eyes vacant with hunger. Mood: bottomless craving.

cards.power: The Puppet-Move. The Speech-and-Balance-Script is deleted from the Hom-Blueprint.
cards.lore: Reverse of Prader-Willi. The Dad-version is naturally silenced; the Nom-version is missing.
cards.gradeReason: Puppet-dance hyena — joyful seizure-movement is immediately performable.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: joyful watercolor. Subject: hyena wrestler on puppet strings, arms raised, laughing mid-seizure. Mood: chaotic joy.

cards.power: The Code-Lock. Attaches Lead-Weights to the DRA-scroll so it cannot be read.
cards.lore: Manages Cell-Specialization. If a Tumor-Suppressor is silenced, Nalignant-Max wins.
cards.gradeReason: Code-lock armored turtle is clear; epigenetic silencing mechanism needs one beat of context.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: heavy watercolor. Subject: spiked turtle covered in padlocks, DNA scroll buried beneath its shell. Mood: sealed, immovable.

cards.power: The Spool-Tightener. Decides how tightly the DNA-Thread is wrapped to block Bio-Hackers.
cards.lore: Acetylation Loosens the thread (Dimmer-Switch turns OR).
cards.gradeReason: Spool-tightener is a function, not a character — describes mechanism rather than inviting performance.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: purple watercolor. Subject: spider wrapping DNA spool with wrench, controlling tightness. Mood: precise, invisible power.

cards.power: The Repair-Strike. The DNA-Fiser-Shield is broken; mutations pile up until the arena catches fire.
cards.lore: Caregiver-Genes. They don't cause cancer directly; they just fall to fix the Double-Strand-Breaks.
cards.gradeReason: Armadillo shield-breaker is vivid; 'caregiver not attacker' nuance requires a beat of explanation.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: dark watercolor. Subject: armored armadillo with shattered shield, mutation-sparks filling arena. Mood: firefighter failure.

cards.power: The Death-Sentence. If Corrupted, he stops checking for errors and the Mutation-Punks run wild.
cards.lore: The Guardian of the Geneme. Triggers Apoptosis-Arnie if the code is too damaged to fix.
cards.gradeReason: Judge who issues death sentences — corrupt judge role is immediately actionable.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: noir watercolor. Subject: owl judge in wig with gavel, mutation-goblins rioting behind when corrupted. Mood: justice collapsing.

cards.power: The Fusion-Weapon. Nanual-9 and Nanual-22 fuse to create a Monster-Kinase-Switch stuck ON.
cards.lore: Screams at White-Blood-Cells to divide forever. Defeated by Imati-the-Tyrosine-Tamer.
cards.gradeReason: Chromosome-fusion chameleon with stuck-ON kinase — fusion weapon is immediately performable.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: explosive watercolor. Subject: chameleon fusing two glowing scrolls (9+22) into a weapon, kinase beam firing. Mood: unstoppable fusion.

cards.power: The Typo-Spreader. The Spell-Checker is broken; every Typo becomes permanent, leading to early Colon-Cancers.
cards.lore: Not a Polyp-Counter problem, but a base-pair Correction-Failure.
cards.gradeReason: Woodpecker destroying spell-checker is fun; Microsatellite-instability stat needs context to fully land.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: chaotic ink. Subject: woodpecker shredding a spelling-checker device, typo-blood spraying everywhere. Mood: uncorrectable chaos.

cards.power: The Milk-Poison. Cannot process Galactose-Sugar; it turns into Toxic-Alcohol that destroys eyes and liver.
cards.lore: Sugar-Tokens accumulate in the lens, causing Cloud-the-Cataract.
cards.gradeReason: Toxic-milk zombie cat — milk-poison is visceral and immediately understood.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: toxic watercolor. Subject: kitten wrestler vomiting green from milk bottle, eyes clouding over. Mood: sweet turned lethal.

cards.power: The Oxidative-Snap. Without the Protection-Enzyme, oxidative stress causes Red-Cells to explode.
cards.lore: The Spleen-Sentry takes a Bite out of damaged cells to remove the Heinz Bodies.
cards.gradeReason: Fava bean triggers red cell explosion — the trigger mechanic is instantly graspable.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: explosive watercolor. Subject: crab wrestler being attacked by green oxidative monster, red cell orbs exploding. Mood: triggered detonation.

cards.power: The Muscle-Clog. Glycogen builds up in Lysosome-Closets until the Heart-and-Muscle-Engines seize up.
cards.lore: The only Glycogen-Storage-Disease that is also a Lysosomal-Storage-Disease.
cards.gradeReason: Bull-heart seizing from clog is vivid; lysosome-closet concept needs one beat of context.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: industrial watercolor. Subject: bull wrestler with clogged heart engine, glycogen sludge overflowing from chest. Mood: engine seizing.

cards.power: The Marrow-Crowd. Fat-Filled-Macrophages crowd out the Bone-Marrow-Factory, lowering Platelet-Stats.
cards.lore: The most common Lysosomal Storage Disease. The macrophages look like Crinkled-Tissue-Paper.
cards.gradeReason: Marrow-factory crowding metaphor is solid; crinkled-paper macrophage detail rewards prior knowledge.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: anatomical watercolor. Subject: interior of bone with fat-stuffed macrophage bears crowding out platelet workers. Mood: factory overcrowded.

cards.power: The Big-Picture-Scan. Shows the Large-Scale-Blueprint layout. Finds extra chromosomes or missing arms.
cards.lore: Cannot see Small-Typo-Mutations. It only sees the Whole-Manual arrangement.
cards.gradeReason: Eagle surveying chromosomes from above — map metaphor is clear but tool cards need context.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: cartographic watercolor. Subject: eagle-warrior hovering over giant chromosome map grid. Mood: aerial, systematic.

cards.power: The Specific-Targeter. Uses a Neon-Flashlight to see if a specific Code-Sequence is present or missing.
cards.lore: Excellent for finding DiGeorge-the-Deleter. If the light doesn't blink, the code is gone.
cards.gradeReason: Anglerfish glowing probe is atmospheric; specificity vs. karyotype distinction needs context.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: bioluminescent watercolor. Subject: deep-sea anglerfish using neon probe to light up DNA helix sequence. Mood: targeted, glowing.

cards.power: The Signal-Booster. Takes a tiny invisible Snippet-of-Code and makes millions of copies for the Bio-Hacker.
cards.lore: The foundation of diagnostics. Used for Repeat-Offender counting.
cards.gradeReason: Octopus photocopier — copy-machine metaphor is universally instant.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: industrial comedy watercolor. Subject: octopus running DNA photocopier, A-T-C-G papers flying everywhere. Mood: productive chaos.

cards.power: The Rapid-Translator. Reads the entire Source-Code in a single session, finding every Typo and Deletion.
cards.lore: The ultimate Bio-Hacker tool. Sequences 3 billion letters in days.
cards.gradeReason: Cyber-crow reading code is cool; massively-parallel vs. exome distinction needs context.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: cyberpunk watercolor. Subject: armored raven reading streaming DNA code on massive screen, data flooding. Mood: omniscient speed.

cards.power: The Cut-and-Paste. Finds a Typo in the code, Cuts it out, and Pastes in the correct version.
cards.lore: Derived from bacterial Immune-Systems.
cards.gradeReason: Scissors cutting DNA — cut-and-paste is the most universally understood tech metaphor in genetics.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: vivid watercolor. Subject: mantis-scissors warrior snipping DNA strand, replacing bad code with glowing patch. Mood: precise, revolutionary.

cards.power: The Code-Delivery. Uses a Neutralized-Virus-Shell to smoggle a Good-Blueprint into the cells.
cards.lore: The Trejan-Horse of genetics. The virus Infects the wrestler with the Cure.
cards.gradeReason: Trojan-horse virus-truck is a great metaphor; AAV vs. Lentivirus distinction needs context.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: sci-fi watercolor. Subject: armored virus-box on spider legs smuggling DNA cargo through cell membrane. Mood: covert delivery.

cards.power: The Message-Shredder. Stops a Corrupted-Blueprint by Shredding the mftNA instructions.
cards.lore: Used to silence Toxic-Gain mutations like Hunting-the-Dance
cards.gradeReason: Ant shredder squad is fun; mRNA-specific silencing mechanism needs one beat of context.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: action watercolor. Subject: squad of ant-soldiers destroying mRNA scrolls with industrial shredder. Mood: coordinated destruction.

cards.power: The Identity-Reset. A Universal-Player that can be Recoded and re-inserted to fix a damaged organ.
cards.lore: Can be Trained to become a neuron, a muscle, or a liver cell.
cards.gradeReason: Axolotl rebooting is perfectly chosen animal; iPSC vs. natural stem cell distinction adds needed context.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: glowing watercolor. Subject: axolotl wrestler flexing in rainbow light, morphing silhouettes behind it. Mood: infinite potential.

cards.power: The Early-Blueprint-Look. Draws fluid from the Uterine-Fortress to check the Fetal-Knight's blueprints.
cards.lore: Samples the shed cells floating in the Amniotic-Sea.
cards.gradeReason: Heron-needle stabbing amniotic sac is specific; 15-20 weeks timing stat needs clinical context.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: delicate watercolor. Subject: armored heron piercing glowing pink sphere, drawing blueprint fluid. Mood: precise, risky.

cards.power: The First-Look. Snaps a tiny piece of Placenta-Phil to check the code earier in the match.
cards.lore: The placenta and baby share the same Source-Code.
cards.gradeReason: Crab snatching placenta tree is vivid; earlier-than-amnio distinction needs clinical context.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: organic watercolor. Subject: armored crab clawing tiny sample from glowing placenta tree. Mood: early intelligence gathering.

cards.power: The Stealth-Scanner. Finds tiny Fetal-Code-Scraps floating in the mother's blood.
cards.lore: No risk to the Fetal-Knight. It's a Screen, not a Diagnostic-Verdict.
cards.gradeReason: Blood-spy raccoon panning for fetal DNA — stealth scanner identity is instant and cool.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: noir watercolor. Subject: raccoon spy panning through red blood river for glowing DNA fragments. Mood: covert, non-invasive.

cards.power: The Leak-indicator. If the spine isn't closed, AFP Leaks into the mother's blood, triggering the alarm.
cards.lore: High AFP = Spma-the-Split-Spine. Low AFP = Trisomy-the-Three.
cards.gradeReason: Lizard leaking signal is atmospheric; bidirectional AFP logic (high vs. low) needs clinical knowledge.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: alarm watercolor. Subject: lizard warrior with leaking spine-shield, AFP alarm siren glowing red. Mood: warning signal.

cards.power: The Cartilage-Curb. The Growth-Switch is stuck on STOP, preventing bones from stretching.
cards.lore: A Gain-of-Function in a Negative-Regulator. Short-Limbed but Big-Headed.
cards.gradeReason: Bulldog king on bone throne — growth-switch-on-STOP is instantly physical and embody-able.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: regal watercolor. Subject: bulldog king enthroned on bones, stumpy limbs, oversized crown-head. Mood: small but sovereign.

cards.power: The Metal-Poisoning. The Copper-Export-Pump is broken; Copper-Tokens build up in brain and liver.
cards.lore: Look for the Golden-Rings. Treated by Penicilla-the-Copper-Claw.
cards.gradeReason: Copper-vomiting badger with golden rings — toxic treasure king is immediately embodiable.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: metallic watercolor. Subject: badger wrestler vomiting copper coins, Kayser-Fleischer golden rings around eyes. Mood: toxic wealth.

cards.power: The Filter-and-Frequence-Fail. The Basement-Membrane-Mesh is weak; Kidney-Filters leak and Ear-Sensors fail.
cards.lore: Can't See, Can't Pee, Can't Hear a Bee.
cards.gradeReason: 'Can't See, Can't Pee, Can't Hear a Bee' — best mnemonic in the deck, instantly performed.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: spotted watercolor. Subject: dalmatian with crumbling kidney-filter backpack, hearing aid sparking, vision blurring. Mood: triple failure.

cards.power: The Iron-Rust. The Iron-Gate is stuck open; Rust-Tokens destroy the heart, liver, and pancreas.
cards.lore: The wrestler turns Bronze and gets diabetes. Treated by Blood-Letting-Leech.
cards.gradeReason: Rusting iron rhino turning bronze — iron overload as rusting is visceral and immediate.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: rusty watercolor. Subject: rhino wrestler covered in rust-gears, bronze skin, leech draining excess iron. Mood: oxidized power.

cards.power: The Generational-Speedup. Every time the Repeat-Offender is passed on, the match starts earlier.
cards.lore: Classic in Hunting-the-Dance. The DNA-polymerase Slips more each time.
cards.gradeReason: Cheetah bursting through ancestral portraits is vivid; generational-slippage mechanism needs context.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: velocity watercolor. Subject: cheetah running through family portraits, each generation faster and more severe. Mood: accelerating doom.

cards.power: The Split-Persona. Only some of the wrestler's cells have the Trisomy-Glitch, making the phenotype milder.
cards.lore: Caused by a Post-Zygotic-Error.
cards.gradeReason: Half-gold half-crumble cat is striking; post-zygotic-error mechanism needs genetics context.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: split watercolor. Subject: cat wrestler exactly half gold-armored, half crumbled stone, two distinct cell armies behind. Mood: divided self.

cards.power: The Random-Battery. Power-Failure severity depends entirely on the Bad-Battery-Ratio.
cards.lore: Explains why two siblings with the same mitochondrial disease have totally different Power-Levels.
cards.gradeReason: Battery-ratio squirrel is clear; heteroplasmy threshold concept needs mitochondrial background.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: electric watercolor. Subject: squirrel with mix of glowing and dead batteries, lightning crackling unpredictably. Mood: random power.

cards.power: The Parental-Tag. The body Stamps a gene to turn one parental version OFF.
cards.lore: Explains why Prader-Willi and Angelman look totally different despite being the same Deletion.
cards.gradeReason: Penguin notary stamping parental tags is clever; parent-of-origin silencing needs prior imprinting context.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: official watercolor. Subject: penguin in suit stamping MOM and DAD tags on DNA scrolls, one always silenced. Mood: bureaucratic fate.

cards.power: The Bareods-Reader: Each chromosome has a unique Stripe-Pattern to show niasing chapters.
cards.lore: Dark bands are Gene-Poor; light bands are Gene-Rich.
cards.gradeReason: Zebra barcode-scanner is a perfect image; gene-rich vs. gene-poor banding detail needs background.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: precise watercolor. Subject: zebra scanning its own barcode stripes with handheld reader, chromosome pattern revealed. Mood: self-reading.

cards.power: The Quantity-Checker. Compares wrestler's DBA te a Noraal-Standard te find Ridden-Deletions or Estrs-Duplication.
cards.lore: Cannot see Balanced-Swaps, but is the king of finding Coyy-Nuaber-Variants.
cards.gradeReason: Kangaroo on scales comparing DNA quantities is clear; CNV specificity vs. chromosomal resolution needs context.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: scientific watercolor. Subject: kangaroo holding golden scales, DNA samples balanced against normal standard. Mood: precise comparison.

cards.power: The Letter-by-Letter-Verification. Reads the code one letter at a time to confirm a Single-Typo.
cards.lore: Slower than RGS, but 100% accurate for confirming a specific Glitch-Spot.
cards.gradeReason: Sloth reading DNA letter-by-letter is perfectly chosen; gold-standard vs. speed tradeoff needs context.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: deliberate watercolor. Subject: sloth in thick glasses tracing ATCG sequence stone letter by letter. Mood: meticulous slowness.

cards.power: The Efficiency-Hack. Ignores Junk-DNA and only reads the 1% of the code that builds Proteins.
cards.lore: 85% of disease-causing mutations are found in the Exome. High-Yield-Hacking.
cards.gradeReason: Meerkat highlighting coding regions is focused; 1% of genome coding concept needs molecular biology context.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: efficient watercolor. Subject: meerkat frantically highlighting only essential lines in giant book, junk pages flying aside. Mood: laser focus.

cards.power: The Root-Cause-Finder.
cards.lore: Treat the code, understand the outcome. Look for the family ghost or the match is a mystery!
cards.gradeReason: Doc FrizzleBob with magnifying pedigree — detective-geneticist role is immediately owned.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: detective watercolor. Subject: rabbit doctor with magnifying glass over bleeding pedigree tree. Mood: urgent discovery.

cards.power: Clinical Recognition
cards.lore: Long fingers, high Elastic-Stats + sudden Chest-Bursting-Ache = Identify the Stretcher and the lethal Aortic-Snap.
cards.gradeReason: Synthesis challenge card — requires knowing Marfan features to perform; describes rather than invites.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: clinical watercolor. Subject: giraffe with aortic explosion, long-finger stats visible on card edges. Mood: diagnostic emergency.

cards.power: The Imprint-Stamp Duel
cards.lore: Both are Chapter 15 deletions. Explain why the Dad-Deletion vs Mom-Deletion dictates totally different arenas.
cards.gradeReason: Requires knowing both Prader-Willi and Angelman to engage — pure knowledge-check, not performative.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: duel watercolor. Subject: hippo and hyena facing off, chromosome 15 visible between them. Mood: mirror opposites.

cards.power: The Enzyme-Fail Matrix
cards.lore: Fava beans trigger the explosion. Identify the G6PD Fail and the Heinz-Bodies mechanism.
cards.gradeReason: Clinical scenario card — fava trigger is fun but card reads as test question, not invitation.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: explosive watercolor. Subject: crab and fava bean bowl, red cells exploding, Heinz body specks visible. Mood: trigger-happy.

verdict: The Genetic Codebreaker is one of the strongest MedKayfab entries — 23 G1 cards in a genetics deck is genuinely impressive. Hunting-the-Dance and Alport's 'Can't See, Can't Pee' mnemonic alone justify the deck. The weak spot is page 14 (Lab Labyrinth Preview), which carries the most font artifacts and the driest content. The three Synthesis Quest cards work as challenge rounds but feel like exam questions rather than performance invitations. Table-ready: Yes.
blurb: 56 genetics wrestlers from Fragile-X to CRISPR — where chromosomes brawl and your pedigree is your power. For med students who learn best by playing the disease.

coverQA.coverVisual: 5 — FrizzleBob in lab coat hacking DNA machinery, explosive energy, perfect character anchor
coverQA.coverTitle: 5 — 'Source Code Sabotage & The Blueprint Rebellion' is punchy and memorable
coverQA.coverVibeMatch: 5 — punk-educational genome-hacker aesthetic perfectly matches deck content
coverQA.coverOriginality: 4 — strong but follows established MedKayfab template; DNA-computer hybrid machine is fresh
coverQA.coverViral: 4 — 'Genetic Codebreaker' is searchable; 'Stay fluffy' tagline is signature brand
coverQA.coverNote: Best cover in the MedKayfab series so far. The DNA-as-computer metaphor is crystallized beautifully. 'Call Doc Frizzle!' and 'What the FLUFF?!' corner gags are perfect brand touchstones.

notes: Heavy font-rendering artifacts throughout, especially pages 4 (Repeat Offenders) and 14 (Lab Labyrinth Preview). Confirmed artifacts include: 'LGRE:' for LORE, 'PONER:' for POWER, 'PGNER:' for POWER, 'Risfelded' for Misfolded, 'Saio-of-Function' for Gain-of-Function, 'Ritochondrial' for Mitochondrial, 'DRA-scroll' for DNA, 'DBA' for DNA, 'Bareods-Reader' for Barcode-Reader, 'Niature' for Mixture, 'Nacro-Orchidism' for Macro-Orchidism, and ~35 additional substitution artifacts. Readability still workable due to context, but print QA required before Gumroad release. Page 14 is worst affected. The page 15 Synthesis Quest cards function as clinical scenario challenges — different format from standard cards. KayfaBINGO and KayfaBOGGLE exclamation callouts visible on pages 2 and 4.
